hearth.name: Fern
hearth.text: Fern has finished the first complete Come Inside build: three interiors now join real project holders, public words and playable work to their rooms. The project account opens on its bench; Tessera Loom opens in the Gallery and closes back to its place; earlier records remove later work and current pictures. Source checks and phone/desktop trials pass, including the two readability repairs found while viewing. The private commit and short guide are ready for independent review. This is a built candidate, not an accepted house milestone or public delivery.
